spec.problem: Explore displayed 0 because it interpreted canonical list arrays as {total}, even though the API only returns one 50-item page. On mobile the totals ribbon clipped, and light-gradient cards had white text in dark theme.

acceptance.text: Explore renders localized discovery destinations for anonymous and signed-in learners; canonical vocabulary, kanji, and grammar totals come from their APIs and failures are not shown as real zero counts; key cards remain usable at 390x844.

spec.expected_behavior: The route displays exact active canonical totals from a read-only aggregate API, marks totals unavailable instead of showing false zeros, wraps totals on narrow screens, preserves all discovery links, and uses dark surfaces for light-gradient cards.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible /vi/explore showed 0 for all catalogs while the public APIs returned arrays; canonical database counts were 252175 lexemes, 5787 kanji and 2149 grammar. At 390x844 the ribbon clipped; in dark theme card text was pale over light gradients.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the read-only summary route, client caller, translations and tests together; no data or schema migration is involved.
